lines.text: One of the oldest inhabited lands on Earth, ruled by empire after empire, and still at the heart of an unresolved conflict. This is the story of Palestine.
About twenty million years ago a rift began opening here. Today it holds the Dead Sea, whose salty shore is the lowest dry land on Earth.
In the Jordan valley, people settled at Jericho about eleven thousand years ago, and built a stone tower and walls, among the first signs of town life.
On the coast, Gaza grew into a busy port, one of the ancient cities of the land.
After centuries of Ottoman rule came the First World War. In 1917 Britain promised a national home for the Jewish people in Palestine.
From 1920 Britain ruled the land under a mandate, as Jewish immigration grew and tensions with the Arab population rose.
Yasser Arafat would lead the Palestine Liberation Organization for decades, and share a Nobel Peace Prize for the Oslo agreements.
Mahmoud Abbas, his long-time colleague, would later succeed him as president of the Palestinian Authority.
And Mahmoud Darwish would give his people their words, becoming their national poet.
In 1948 the mandate ended and the State of Israel was declared. Neighbouring Arab states went to war.
For Palestinians it was the Nakba, the catastrophe. Some seven hundred thousand fled or were driven from their homes.
The next year the United Nations set up an agency to care for the Palestinian refugees.
In 1964 the Palestine Liberation Organization was founded, to speak for the Palestinian people.
In June 1967, in six days of war, Israel took the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip, and the occupation began.
Twenty years later, in 1987, Palestinians in the occupied lands rose up, in the First Intifada.
In 1988 the State of Palestine was declared, for the West Bank, East Jerusalem and Gaza. Most countries now recognise it.
In 1993 Israel and the PLO signed the Oslo Accords, and for a time peace seemed possible.
A year later the Palestinian Authority was set up, to govern parts of the West Bank and Gaza.
But talks broke down, and in 2000 a second uprising began, years of bloodshed on both sides.
After the Hamas attack on Israel of the seventh of October 2023, war came to Gaza, and most of the strip was destroyed.
From ancient Jericho to the ruins of Gaza, the story of this land is still waiting for peace.
